tools.name: search_cabinets
tools.description: Search French accounting firms by exact AND filters. First use resolve_city for ambiguous locations and get_taxonomies for exact category values. q is a firm name or SIREN, never a service query. Preserve every user constraint: on zero results, do not remove a filter or widen the city without agreem

tools.name: find_accountants
tools.description: Parse a simple French or English request such as 'Comptable LMNP à Lyon utilisant Pennylane' and search the public catalog with AND filters. This limited deterministic parser asks for clarification before searching if words, negations, multiple values or conflicting locations cannot be represented.

tools.name: get_cabinet
tools.description: Lire une fiche par slug obtenu dans search_cabinets : identité, adresse, informations juridiques recensées, activités, sources et URL canonique. Dates inconnues explicites. Les informations sont à confirmer, sans certification de compétence.

tools.name: get_city_stats
tools.description: Compter les fiches répertoriées par Ilicompta dans une ville, arrondissements inclus à Paris, Lyon et Marseille. Renvoie couverture, dénominateurs et URL de la page ville. Ce ne sont pas des parts de marché ni un recensement exhaustif.

tools.name: resolve_city
tools.description: Find catalog city slugs by name prefix or postal code. Use before searching when a locality is ambiguous. Return candidates to the user instead of selecting an arbitrary city; no nearby-city expansion.

tools.name: get_taxonomies
tools.description: Read exact sector, service, software and language values accepted by search_cabinets. Presence in the vocabulary does not mean a specific firm has that capability. Never replace an unknown requested criterion with a broader category without user agreement.
